import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Define the target schema columns and their types
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Data types for enforcing target schema
    dtype_map = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',  # Nullable integer
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    }

    # List to hold dataframes from each source
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure all target columns exist in source
        missing_cols = set(target_columns) - set(df.columns)
        if missing_cols:
            raise ValueError(f"Source file {file_path} is missing columns: {missing_cols}")

        # Select only target columns (in correct order)
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Convert columns to target dtypes
        # For string columns, convert to string dtype (pandas string dtype)
        # For integer columns, convert to Int64 (nullable integer) to handle missing values safely
        for col, dtype in dtype_map.items():
            if dtype == 'string':
                df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
            elif dtype == 'Int64':
                # Nullable integer type, convert safely
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
            else:
                df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If needed, sort or reset index (already reset by ignore_index=True)
    # target_df = target_df.sort_values(by='starttime').reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
